videos.title: Roblox News Today: Net a Fish Turkey Boss, Easier Kids & Select & 4 New Codes 🚨 #roblox
videos.description:
Today's Roblox news: Net a Fish's Thanksgiving update adds the Great Gobbler turkey boss, the Bloodmaw world boss, a Thanksgiving Pass and a corn Market, Throw Food For Animals has a Thanksgiving feast event with 21 limited animals (ends Nov 28), and games now need 100 Highly Engaged Players instead of 250 to reach Kids & Select, with counts updating every hour in Creator Hub. Plus 3 games have 4 new codes.

0:32 Throw Food For Animals Thanksgiving Feast

1:20 Coming Up + Outro

Codes in this video:
Net a Fish: 20MVISITS (2 Trait Rolls + 15 min x2 Luck, Money, Pearls and Fish Caught), THANKSGIVING (15 min x2 Luck, Money, Pearls and Fish Caught)
Practical Basketball: THANKSGIVING2026 (15,000 Coins + 2x Badge XP for 3 games; join the Practical's Games group first)
The Ditch Hotel: THANKSGIVING (10k Cash + 1 Revive)

Codes may expire at any time, so redeem them fast! Event times are in Eastern Time and can change.
